title: Pan-Seared Jewel Toned Trout with Broccoli Gratin
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring pan-seared trout and a creamy broccoli gratin. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season trout fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add trout fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer trout to a baking dish and bake for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
In the same skillet, add remaining 1 tbsp butter. Add broccoli florets and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, combine grated cheese and heavy cream. Heat over low heat, stirring until smooth.
Pour cheese sauce over cooked broccoli and transfer to the oven.
Bake broccoli gratin for an additional 5-7 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.
Serve trout with broccoli gratin spooned over the top.
